mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_ledger (ledger_no, settlement_id, account_type, account_id, subject, direction, amount, env_flag, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{ledgerNo}, #{settlementId}, #{accountType}, #{accountId}, #{subject}, #{direction}, #{amount}, #{envFlag}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT account_type AS accountType, direction, SUM(amount) AS total FROM t_ledger WHERE settlement_id = #{settlementId} AND deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY account_type, direction
